title: Fix the dim night light
story: Board 1 from the first batch lights its LED very dimly. With test firmware holding the PWM pin high and a 4.5 V supply, you measure only about 4.2 mA through the LED, while the simulation says 18.8 mA. The transistor is saturated (its collector is at 0.04 V), so the problem is the LED's series resistor, slot S1: the assembler may have used a resistor from the wrong reel. Put in the part that brings the LED back to 15-20 mA without the resistor dissipating more than 0.1 W.

goals.label: the resistor dissipates at most 0.1 W

hints: 4.2 mA through about 1.4 V means R = 1.4 / 0.0042, about 330 ohm: the wrong reel.
